title: Pocket Pet Star Camp
premise: A bright, kid-friendly virtual pet game where the player adopts a dog, cat, or hamster and cares for it through tiny arcade minigames to earn five stars.
interaction_model: Mobile-first touch and mouse interaction with menu buttons, drag/move control for care tasks, and tap-to-jump input for the race minigame.
objective: Raise the pet's hunger, hygiene, and fun meters through matching activities, convert full meters into stars, and collect 5 stars to complete the camp.
progression: Choose a pet, enter the camp hub, rotate between feeding, cleaning, and racing activities, fill stat bars to 100 for star rewards, and reach the 5-star win screen.
theme: Cozy pet-care summer camp with playful toy-like visuals and cheerful reward feedback.
mood: Wholesome, colorful, forgiving, bubbly, and upbeat.
likely_audience: Children, families, and casual mobile players who enjoy cute virtual pet loops and simple minigames.
confidence_notes: High confidence that this is a virtual pet care game with three stat-building minigames.
High confidence that stars are the main win progression and 5 stars triggers completion.
Moderate confidence that the camp setting is mostly presentational rather than a deep management layer.
Moderate confidence that sleep is a light flavor interaction instead of a major resource system.
recreation_prompt: Create a cheerful mobile-first virtual pet game called 'Pocket Pet Star Camp' where the player starts on a bright selection screen and chooses one of three pets: a dog, a cat, or a hamster. After selection, show a cozy outdoor camp hub with a cute animated pet standing on a grassy path under a pastel sky, clouds, pennants, and sparkly decorative effects. Display a HUD with a 0-to-5 star counter, a current mode label, and three care meters for hunger, hygiene, and fun. Give the player four large bottom buttons: feed, shower, race, and sleep. Feed should launch a minigame where apples fall from the top of the screen and the player moves the pet horizontally with touch or mouse movement to catch them, increasing hunger. Shower should launch a cleaning minigame where muddy spots appear over the pet and the player rubs or swipes them away to increase hygiene. Race should launch a side-view obstacle minigame where the pet runs near the left side and the player taps or clicks to jump over incoming rocks, increasing fun whenever obstacles are cleared. Sleep should trigger a short dreamy overlay and pause-like break with a small tradeoff that lowers some other stats afterward. Whenever any one stat reaches 100, award a celebratory star, reset that stat back to around half so the loop can continue, and play positive audiovisual feedback. End the game with a festive win screen once 5 stars have been earned. Use a friendly family-oriented tone, oversized rounded UI, bright candy colors, bouncy pet animation, short instructional overlays for each minigame, quick sound feedback, and a forgiving loop designed for short casual play sessions on phones or desktop.
